description: §42.4: the explicit pair is `bool`-valued — legal in value positions and as `&&` operands; `a is given && a > 0` narrows `a`.
rationale: §42.4 statement 7: "Compounds and value positions spell presence explicitly: `x is given` (present) / `x is not` (absent)"; statement 8: "`x is given` … narrows it to `T` where the test is true … including the right operand of `&&` / `||`". Provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S460 "a′, go" (supersedes S440 Truthiness Q2 for conditions; keeps S440 #4 = (c), Q1, Gotcha Q2, S442).
